reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getBudgetableCategories helper shared by the other month-wide actions and uses getSheetValue/setBudget/isTrackingBudget.

duplication.why: Only the small income-skip guard and sign flip that every sibling action repeats inline are repeated; the selection rule itself is shared.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts beside its siblings and is registered undoable in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Focused, except for an unrelated loosening of BudgetData.goal_def from string | null to unknown.

maintainability.why: Follows the established pattern and stays in sync with the selection rule; the unexplained type loosening is a small wart.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getBudgetableCategories like setZero and the average actions.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the per-category guard matches the sibling pattern openly.
